title: Low Fouling Tower Fill - Film Fill Compromised Water
description: Low fouling cooling tower is the most tolerant for contaminants, but it is a lower performance fill. Learn more about film fill for compromised water.

layout.title: Low Fouling Tower Fill - Film Fill Compromised Water

paragraphs: Low fouling fill is the lowest performance film fill but is also the most tolerant to contaminants such as high suspended solids, oils & fats or scaling and micro biological elements.
